title: Relay stats: fix-round rate, role times and owner wait per run, from the ledger

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Retrospective (docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md, Appendix A) computed run time, fix rounds, role times and idle gaps by hand from slicer relay-run list --json. R4 asks to measure whether the implementer self-check (S115) lowers the fix-round rate; R2 targets owner wait time. ork can show these from the ledger it already reads.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/source/source.go:108` (the Runs part, relay-run list): keep step begin and end times.
- `internal/tui/` (a stats panel on the project page, proposed) and `docs/dashboard.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Per project: runs, pass rate, median run time, share of runs with a fix round, median time per role, and time spent paused for the owner, over the last N runs. Read-only; no new state file. Step times are only as good as the ledger phases. Mark the panel proposed.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/source ./internal/tui; goldens; slicer check; adj lint. UI slice: UI pass (r14).
